en: You're paying him to take the year off, aren't you? That way you can sign him when he re-enters the draft next year.
You know this kind of backdoor deal caused a huge stink before. I didn't think anyone was dumb enough to still try it.
So, what kind of money did you have to flash? Not just ten or twenty million, I bet.
The kid dreamed of becoming a Wyvern. I bet it took a whole lot of persuading. Maybe even something like a hundred million?
Come on, what's your problem? Let us go already!

Take me to Kurashina, then. We need to chat. Or would you
rather start round two of getting your asses kicked?
(Oh, there's Kurashina... Who's he got with him?)
Yo, Kurashina. You done with your little talk?
Yes. It's all over. I cut off all negotiations with the Wyverns.
You did? Great! Good going. You leave the rest up to me.
Don't worry, Kurashina. You made the right choice. Signing with a lost cause like the Wyverns would only stunt your career.
Uh, right.
(What was up with that guy? Is he a scout from another team? It's time I go into stealth mode... follow 'em around for a bit!)
Hey, dipshit. Turn the fuck around.
You got a good reason for snooping around in Kurashina's affairs? Huh!?
Oh, you see, uh... Who did you say you were?
Shut up! We're the ones asking the questions, asshole!
Let me guess. You're working with the guy who walked off with Kurashina just now.

This nosy motherfucker... You better get your ass over here.
I get the impression the folks around here won't be able to
stomach what's about to go down.
And if I say no?
Simple. We'll cave your face in on the spot!
Tatsuo! You are okay? There is no injury?
Yup, I'm fine. What about you? Looks like your seaweed isn't too ruffled.
Oui! Completely, it is your doing. Merci, Tatsuo.
Thank you so much, Shinada-san. I wasn't prepared for this. It's my fault. I'm terribly sorry.
Hehe, I thought it was a little too easy for such a high-paying job.
Haha, after what happened, it might not be enough. Here is your pay, as promised.

Woohoo, a million sure makes a hefty bundle! Or...
wait a minute. Why is this only 4,000 yen? What
happened to the one million yen?
I said no such thing. I said a million, and meant a million Vietnamese dong, not a million yen.
Vietnamese dong?
Yes, by current exchange rates, 250 Vietnamese dong is worth around one yen.
In other words, a million Vietnamese dong is worth...
Four thousand yen!
<Italic>Four thousand yen!</Italic>
Four... thousand... yen!

You don't have to say it over and over. Damn it all!
I got screwed by Vietnamese dong!
Hahaha, a million yen for an hour? You don't honestly think that much was actually on the table?
I guess it's only fair. I wasn't much of a tour guide, either.
Oh, Matsuno, cheap-fisted you are like always. Money, I have not with me. So sorry, Tatsuo.
No, no, it's all right. I got to spend time with the world's top songstress. It was fun, and I got to eat some tebasaki, too!
Oh, Matsuno, cheap-fisted you are like always. Money, I carry not with me.
Tatsuo, instead, you should be accepting this.
You got a <Color:8>Daddy Papa's Autograph<Color:Default>.
Savior of me you are, Tatsuo. For me, you have risking your life.
That autograph, you can be selling for good money. Today, you will be forgiving me please?
Haha, thanks. It's okay, though. I got to spend time with the world's top songstress. It was fun, and I got to eat some tebasaki, too!
When those men taking me, all the time I am thinking why I be made a victim.
I am a big singer. A special person I am. I am thinking it is unfair I face dangerous situation and even maybe meet my end.
But, it is a mistake. Foolish me. Desperate I was to be special. A goddess among gibbons, I fancied.
But, big singer or no, I lack control over the throes of life and death. In the end, I am ordinary, like everyone else.
When I saw you fighting, an epiphany I had. Seeing ordinary people be brave gives hope to the hopeless. That is what cheers them on.
Before, I try to be writing songs to cheer on the weak. But a pit of hubris did I let myself fall into. That is where my writing failed.
To me, you taught that, Tatsuo.
So, this visit to Japan actually means something to you now?
Naturally! This visiting, it is already inspire me with new poems and music. Next time, you will please be guiding me again.
Hey, you got it. But I gotta warn you, my rate might've gone up to <Italic>ten</Italic> million Vietnamese dong by then!
Very well! Goodbye, Tatsuo. I shall be returning home, but never will I be forgetting you.
You little weasel, where'd you take Daddy Papa!?
Tatsuo! Aidez-moi! Rescue me!
What are you, her bodyguard?
Who are you people? You need to let her go, right now!
Yeah right. All we gotta do is hold this bitch ransom for a year or two, and then we'll be living like kings!
Tatsuooooo!
Whoa, whoa, whoa... What's the big idea, flashing around that nasty piece of work?
Can't have witnesses picking these pretty mugs out of a police lineup, now can we?
(Whew. Guess that's a job well done. But where are Daddy and Matsuno?)
Oh... Oh no!
Hey! Matsuno-san! What happened?
Shinada-san! It's Daddy! These... strange men took her!
They took Daddy? Where!?
Him! That guy over there! He's one of them.
...Time to jet.
Ah! A restaurant de chicken wings! Of course. It is no problem. Coming here first is what we should have done.
Excellent! Okay, Daddy, we really don't have much time. But let's enjoy some sake.
Ta-da! Here we are at an authentic tebasaki stand. That's Nagoya-style chicken wings, by the way. You could say it's a local favorite.
That's all fine and well, but... Don't you think it's a little too out in the open?
Tatsuo, is there not a place in Nagoya where I can relax in peace? I requested such, did I not?
Shinada-san, I apologize, but can you take us somewhere more discreet?
Oh, yeah, sure. If that's what you want...

How does this place strike you? They serve sake and
tebasaki⑬that's chicken wings, the Nagoya way.
Wonderful, Tatsuo! It is the <Italic>ne plus ultra</Italic> of Nagoya indeed!
Not sure what that means, but I assume it's excellent! Okay, Daddy, now let's enjoy ourselves while we still have time.
Haha, it seems an eternity has passed since the delightful kiss of sake caressed my lips. I am afraid I will be un petit tipsy. ♪

Well? How do you like it? Not only can you get drunk off
your feet, an array of beautiful women will help you do it!
Shinada-san... This is a cabaret club. Did you forget our guest is a lady? Granted, her name is Daddy Papa, but still.
Not a problem! Plenty of women drink at cabaret clubs. I'm sure she'll have a great time.
No, Tatsuo. I am far too gorgeous for this setting. Depressed the hostesses will be when they see me among them, a pearl among swine.
It is not my wanting to shame the common people. Take me instead to elsewhere.
Oh... I'm sorry. Let's come up with something else, then.
This here is Club Futo Momo, my favorite erotic massage parlor. Its extravagant decor and befuddlingly buxom beauties make it the finest in town!
I'd say it's one of Kineicho's most symbolic sights⑬even worthy of a world-renowned star such as Your Ladyship!
Shinada-san, while I do appreciate the gesture, I must warn you that Daddy despises this sort of debauchery⑬
Non, non, non! C'est nonsense that I should be offended by this sort of lubricité. You must be more in tune with your desires! Let us admire this ribald display!
Did you think that I would blush beet red like some schoolgirl? How trés simple of you.
I am Daddy Papa, the global megastar. And you see me as naught but a virgin, uninitiated to the tender stirrings of lust. Pish tosh!
Oh... I'm sorry. I meant no disrespect.
Perhaps it would do us both well to remember that nothing crass will make Daddy flinch. After all, she clawed her way up to the height of stardom from the dark depths of poverty.

Perhaps we should move on. Shinada-san, we're finished with
sightseeing. We'll put this behind us and move right along.
To what, exactly?
Well, Daddy always makes it a point to enjoy some Japanese cuisine. You wouldn't mind sharing a drink with her, would you?
Oh, I would love to. So, Her Ladyship requires a dining establishment that serves a good drink? I can work with that.
That would be appreciated. Daddy, do you have any requests?
Ach, Matsuno, can you do nothing outside of depending on my guidance? So much like a child you are, and equally helpless.
Well, I only asked if you had any preferences about where you'd like to go.
Hmm, ah, yes. Then, let it be somewhere that is serving delicacies representative of this here Nagoya. Also, it should let me feel relaxed.
Okay, cool. Let me think for a sec.
(Club Eden's always nice.)
Okay, I know just the place. Right this way, please.
(Sekai no Yamachan ought to fit the bill.)
(Ooh, a chicken wing stand might be what she's looking for.)

Well? From here you can see all of Kineicho. A view truly
fit for a visionary such as Your Ladyship, whose artistry is
apparently far above the reach of the common populace.
Ah, oui! Tatsuo, the view, it is trés magnifique! Truly it is beautiful, and your praise melts my heart. My muse, it is inspired to again work wonders.
Bravo, Shinada-san. I knew you were the man for the job.
Haha, I didn't do much.
Either way, this was an excellent choice. But that's enough sightseeing for now.
What? We're done already?
Our visit is very short, you see. We don't have time to dawdle. Let us move on.
Uh, to what?
Okay, that's cool. Let me think for a sec.
(Club Eden ought to do it.)
Here we are, the illustrious TV tower. It's one of the most iconic landmarks in Nagoya.
I see. You went with a safe choice, Shinada-san.
Hmm. Tatsuo, it is not bad, this building. However, displeasing it is to me. A tower should be looking down upon the great Daddy Papa? Pah! How insulting.
Oh. Didn't see that coming...
I'm sorry, Shinada-san. Daddy can be complex sometimes. Anyway, this will do for sightseeing.
Huh? We're done already?
Our visit is very short. We don't have time to dawdle. Let's move on.
Move on... to what?
(Sekai no Yamachan ought to do it.)
Okay, no more, please! We'll get gone for good!

Thank you! Thank you, good sir! Um, if it's okay, I'd like
to give you this figure as thanks. You'll be good to it,
won't you? Treat it like a lady? ...Stroke it tenderly?
You got a <Color:8>Cutie Girl Figure<Color:Default>.
Yes! I gave the hero a precious item to aid him on his journey! With that, I'll be off!
Hm! Bravo. A most impressive display.

I had the honor of watching you trounce those bullies.
Clearly, you know how to handle yourself under pressure.
Whoa, you were watching the whole time?

I am aware this is out of the blue, but may I interest you
in a job? One that would be right up your alley, judging from that demonstration.

A job? I dunno... I mean, I need one, yes, but I'm tired of
getting roped into shady deals. I pride myself on being a
law-abiding citizen.

Perhaps you have the wrong impression of me. My offer is far
from illegitimate.

You sure? Everything about you screams, "Warning, suspicious
man approaching! Do not engage under any circumstances!"

Oh? Is that so? I chose this getup specifically to avoid
attracting attention⑬I thought it'd help me blend into the
background. Was this a poor choice?

A black suit and glasses, though? That just makes you look
like an assassin. If your goal is to make people not look
at you, then sure, you did your job...

Can we move on, please? The job I'm offering does not
violate any sort of law, I assure you.
The job only entails escorting a certain lady on a tour of this city. It won't be for much time, either.

You want me to be a tour guide? Why would you need someone
good in a fight for that?

A fair point. However, as a dignified diva in a foreign
land, wouldn't you be more comfortable around a man who
exhibits both strength and restraint?
As I said, it won't take much time. Perhaps an hour at most. As compensation for your labor and security, I can offer you a million's worth.
Really!? A million!? Just for showing some lady around town?
Precisely. So, will you agree to those terms?
Nah, I think I'll pass.
Very well. That decision is yours.
